headline: Kusumgar Limited submits depository participant certificate to NSE
hook: Routine compliance filing from Kusumgar Limited
summary: Kusumgar Limited has submitted a regulatory certificate to the stock exchange under SEBI regulations. This is a standard procedural compliance filing required for listed entities regarding depositories and participants. For Indian retail investors, this routine filing carries no direct financial or operational impact.
why_it_matters: No financial impact for retail shareholders.
